about: Modi Naturals Ltd operates across branded consumer foods and edible oils , bulk rice -bran products and grain-based ethanol . The company's edible-oil operations trace back to rice-bran processing. The consumer portfolio now covers premium oils and packaged foods , while ethanol is now manufactured through Modi Biotech Pvt Ltd , a wholly owned subsidiary. [1] [2] [3]
